title: An effective criterion for ergodicity of the extension along a cocycle
author: Przemyslaw Berk; Frank Trujillo
work: Ergodic properties of infinite extension of symmetric interval exchange transformations
difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author's labelled proposition at source lines 1065-1082: if the cocycle is differentiable on the exchanged intervals, if there are Rokhlin towers of bounded height, small base and uniformly small displacement, if the interval spanned by a point and its return lies in a continuity interval, and if the Birkhoff sums of the cocycle and of its derivative obey the stated two-sided bounds, then ergodicity of the product of the base transformation with itself implies ergodicity of the extension. The proof (source lines 1084-1162) is long and its whole content is a translation: each of the four stated conditions has to be matched with the corresponding hypothesis of the Conze-Fraczek criterion, the tower bounds have to be shown to imply its first three numbered conditions, and the Birkhoff-sum bound has to imply its fourth, after which the average of the cocycle is placed in the group of essential values. The statement records the conditions and the conclusion but none of the matching.

proof_spans.label: the complete author proof of the labelled proposition, retained line for line
